new_libraries.name: Companion microSatellite
new_libraries.author: Elliot Matson <https://github.com/elliotmatson>
new_libraries.sentence: Connect ESP32 microcontrollers to Bitfocus Companion via the Companion Satellite API.
new_libraries.paragraph: Turns an ESP32 into a virtual Stream Deck-style surface for Bitfocus Companion: virtual button surfaces with bitmaps/colors/text, layout manifests with per-control styles and LED rings, rotary encoders with step counts, pincode input, button subscriptions, and variables. Requires Companion Satellite API version 1.10.0 or later (Companion v4.3+).

library.name: AMK_CYD_Universal_TFT
library.author: Aung Moe Khine
library.sentence: Universal standalone TFT, touch, sprite, TFT_eSPI_Button, and visual GUI driver for all ESP32 Cheap Yellow Display (CYD) resistive boards.
library.paragraph: Bundles high-speed display and touch drivers with runtime hardware auto-probing for 2.4", 2.8", 3.2", 3.5", and 4.0" CYD resistive boards (ILI9341, ST7789, ST7796, XPT2046, including Dual-USB and ELEGOO 2.8" variants). Features full TFT_eSPI and TFT_eSPI_Button drop-in compatibility, TFT_eSprite off-screen buffering, persistent NVS touch calibration, zero-boilerplate LVGL v8/v9 integration, PlatformIO/Visual Studio support, and seamless SquareLine Studio / EEZ Studio visual GUI builder support.
